company.name: Safaa
company.shortDescription: Saudi digital mental-wellbeing platform: Arabic-first AI companion, guided self-help journeys, and licensed Saudi therapists.
company.description: Safaa is a Saudi platform for mental health and everyday wellbeing, available on iOS and Android. It combines Rafeeq — an Arabic-first AI companion — with guided self-help journeys, mood tracking, breathing exercises, psychological assessments, and booking with licensed Saudi therapists. Built with input from 100+ mental-health specialists, Safaa serves users in their own language and cultural context, addressing stress, sleep, and emotional wellbeing across Saudi Arabia and the region.
